# Check chromatic number (exact using backtracking for small graph)
def is_colorable(G, k):
    nodes = list(G.nodes())
    colors = {}
    
    def backtrack(idx):
        if idx == len(nodes):
            return True
        node = nodes[idx]
        neighbor_colors = {colors[n] for n in G.neighbors(node) if n in colors}
        for c in range(k):
            if c not in neighbor_colors:
                colors[node] = c
                if backtrack(idx + 1):
                    return True
                del colors[node]
        return False
    
    return backtrack(0)
